name: Ordnance Survey Data Hub APIs
description: UK mapping, geocoding, and address lookup APIs from Ordnance Survey. Includes OS Names API for geographic place name search, OS Places API for address verification, and OS Maps API for raster map tiles. Authentication via API key (header or query parameter) or OAuth2.
